evidence.detail: The exact Client menu-dispatch branch for action 454 creates rs/q/a/a from the three action integers and appends it to Client.ie when the action is deferred rather than written immediately.

The exact-current outbound action matrix identifies menu action 454 as C2S41 inventory option 2 / equip alias with payload widgetId, slot, itemId; the class stores exactly three ints and exposes only getters for them.
A later Client flush path iterates Client.ie and serializes every rs/q/a/a entry as opcode 41 using record.a(), record.b(), record.c(), then clears the queue.

Opcode 41 is context-dependent and is not intrinsically Equip: exact-current authority records both normal inventory option-2 behavior and an equip alias. The name therefore identifies the queue/transport slot, not a gameplay verb.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for one deferred C2S41 inventory-option/equip-alias queue record. It is not itself an OutgoingPacket implementation.
